title: docs(id): Joplin importer design against the #2048 object model (#5848)
body: Design record for #5848: importing Joplin into the #2048 object model. `doc/2026-11-08_design_id5848.md` — design only, no importer code. It consumes the #2048 model as landed (`doc/2026-11-01_design_id2048.md`, PR #3885) and does not re-decide it; the one place it touches a parent decision (which head exports for a multi-head note) is recorded explicitly in §7 of the doc. Settled: - **Mapping** — Joplin notes → logical notes (`note.create`, new ID identity, Joplin ID kept only in a persisted import manifest); notebooks → collection notes with typed membership references; tags → observed-remove tag claims, verbatim; to-dos → notes with to-do claims; resources → content blobs with a resource record (filename/MIME as claims). - **Links** — `:/` body references rewritten to structured typed references via the manifest (note vs resource ID spaces kept distinct); dangling references degrade to stored surface + unresolved state, per #2048, and are counted in the import report. - **Round-trip contract** — export back to JEX stated as canonical set equalities (notes, per-note tag sets, link targets, notebook tree, attachment byte hashes), with an explicit lossy list (revision history, plugin markup interpretation, encrypted items, unexported concurrent heads). - **Invariants** — stable ID identity, append-only import with explicit head-joining on re-import, idempotency via the manifest, no silent drops (full import accounting), no E2EE key handling. - **Test corpus plan** — synthetic generated fixtures plus round-trip and idempotency properties; the oracle is canonical set equality modulo the stated lossy list. - **Rejected alternatives** — per-`document.put` import, Markdown-only import without a manifest, and Joplin sync-target emulation for v1, each with reasons. - **Splits filed and linked:** #7675 (Joplin revision-history import), #7676 (continuous sync target vs one-shot import). Closes #5848 Queue: task 12987 (repo-health-code-pilot), lane code-e. Closure route is the one the issue and packet specify: a merged PR carrying a closing keyword, with the decision record in `doc/` linked from the issue. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR?
